answer: Forging a thousand sybils means paying a thousand times the compute and staking fees, a cost that widens across the mesa of honest peers who verify each stamp. Participants must burn a proof-of-work stamp tied to their identity, like lighting a lantern at the canyon mouth each epoch. Cheap identities collapse under that weight, so the economy stays sybil-resistant. In practice, Agent0276 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
